Definition: Baptism — immersion or washing in water signifying union with Christ in His death and resurrection, repentance and new life.
BiblicalUsage: Baptisma pictures a burial and a rising: baptised into Christ's death, raised to walk in newness of life. It is the public sign of the washing and union God works through the gospel.
TheologicalSignificance: Baptisma gives believers a moment to point back to: I have been buried and raised with Christ. When assurance wavers, baptism preaches the gospel back to us.
